title: Halfway lift

steps.text: Fold forward from your hips with a soft bend in your knees.
Rest your hands on your shins and lengthen your back.
steps.cue: Hands on your shins. Lengthen your back.

steps.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears and look slightly ahead.
steps.cue: Shoulders away from your ears. Look a little ahead.

steps.text: Hold for a couple of breaths, then fold down or stand up slowly.
steps.cue: Hold, then fold down or stand up slowly.

mistakes: Rounding the back instead of lengthening it.
regression: Rest your hands on your thighs instead of your shins.
stopIf: Stand up slowly if your lower back hurts.

anatomy.why: The muscles along the spine hold the back long and flat while the back of the legs lengthens.
